text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both posting modest gains with ETH outpacing BTC slightly, suggesting some rotation into altcoins despite Bitcoin's dominant 59.5% market share. The Fear & Greed index at 63 (Greed) with a week-long uptick signals cautious optimism rather than euphoria, supported by steady $80B in daily volume across the market. Overall, sentiment is constructive but measured—traders are bidding up assets without the aggressive FOMO that typically precedes sharp pullbacks.
